fed.meeting_note: the date the Polymarket market closes; the Fed usually announces its decision the day before

signals.name: Borrowing to buy shares (margin debt)
signals.value: +31.4% ($1.48tn in Sep 2026 vs $1.13tn a year earlier)
signals.measured: the same month a year earlier
signals.source: FINRA margin statistics (monthly, about 3 weeks late)

signals.name: Corporate borrowing costs very low (credit spread)
signals.measured: the 10-year Treasury yield (Moody’s Baa corporate yield minus it)

signals.name: Money getting tighter
signals.value: 10-year yield 5.09% vs 4.32% on 16 Apr 2026 (+0.77 pts); largest 6-month rise in the last 6 months +0.99 pts; Fed funds 3.75% vs 5.13% two years earlier
signals.rule: on if the 10-year yield rose 0.75+ pts over 6 months at any time in the last 6 months, or Fed funds is 1.0+ pt above 2 years earlier
signals.measured: 6 months earlier (yield) and 2 years earlier (Fed funds)

signals.name: Credit spreads widening
signals.value: Baa spread 1.46 pts; largest rise above its 3-month low in the last month +0.10 pts; high-yield (junk) spread 3.31 pts vs a 3-month low of 2.60 (+0.71 pts, shown for information)
signals.measured: its lowest level over the previous 3 months

signals.name: Margin debt turning down
signals.value: 3-month average $1.45tn vs $1.41tn for the 3 months before (+3.1%)
signals.rule: on when the latest 3 months average less than the 3 before

signals.name: Prices up while fear is up
signals.value: 2 of the last 21 trading days (today: Nasdaq 100 -3.1%, its fear gauge VXN 25.6, +25.4%)
signals.rule: on at 8+ days with the Nasdaq 100 up AND VXN up 10%+

bubble.hy_note: Early warning: the high-yield (junk) spread is +0.71 pts above its 3-month low (3.31 vs 2.60); in past cycles it turned first, by a median of about 7 months.

rule.late: 2 or more of the 3 excess signs
rule.breaking: Money getting tighter AND credit spreads widening AND (margin debt turning down OR prices up while fear is up)
rule.override: O7: while Breaking, a Buy or Strong Buy on a stretched stock (price 29%+ above its 200-day average, or P/E 25%+ above its own 5-year median) is capped at Hold

bubble.history: Back-checked on monthly data 1998-2026: Breaking first fired in Aug 2000, Oct 2007 and Mar 2022, each within 0-5 months of the market top and before most of the fall (S&P 500 then fell a further 40%, 53% and 21%). False alarms: Aug 2011, Nov 2018 and Mar 2023, after which the S&P 500 was 14-28% higher a year later. It confirms a top is probably in; it does not call it in advance.
